description: Search news EVENTS: clusters of articles about the same real-world happening, with a title, summary, date, location, key concepts and article count. Best for "what is happening with X" — one event replaces dozens of near-duplicate articles. Cost: 5 tokens (measured live) per call within the last 31 days (default); allow_archive=true costs extra per year touched. At least one of keyword / concept_uris / category_uris / source_uris / location_uris is required. Defaults to 10 events, newest first; use sort_by="size" for the biggest stories. Use get_event for details on one. For companies, people, places or organisations, resolve them with suggest_concepts first and pass concept_uris; keyword is for free terms/topics and is noisy with common words (e.g. "Telefónica" also matches the Spanish adjective "telefónica").

allow_archive.description: Default false: search only the last 31 days (cheapest). Set true to reach the historical archive, which costs extra tokens per year queried; requires date_start and a range of at most 1 year.

category_uris.description: Category URIs, e.g. "news/Business" (use suggest_categories). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

concept_uris.description: Concept URIs for entities: companies, people, places, organisations. PREFERRED over keyword for any named entity: first call suggest_concepts (free) to resolve the name, then pass the returned `uri` here. Multiple values are OR-ed and far more precise than keyword, which avoids homonym noise. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

date_end.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); must be >= date_start. With allow_archive the date_start → date_end (default today) span may be at most 1 year.

date_start.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Must be within the last 31 days unless allow_archive=true, which makes date_start mandatory.

keyword.description: Free-text keyword or phrase, for topics and general terms (e.g. "inflation", "wildfire"). Do NOT use it for companies, people, places or organisations: common words double as names (e.g. "Telefónica" also matches the ordinary Spanish adjective "telefónica") and produce irrelevant results. For those entities call suggest_concepts first and pass the returned URI in concept_uris.

lang.description: 3-letter ISO 639-3 language codes, e.g. "spa" or ["eng", "spa"]. OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

location_uris.description: Location URIs where the news happened (use suggest_locations). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

min_articles_in_event.description: Only events covered by at least this many articles (filters noise).

sort_by.description: Sort order (default date). "size" = most articles first.

source_uris.description: News source URIs, e.g. "bbc.co.uk" (use suggest_sources). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

name: search_events
